sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 11:42

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 11:42:1
items.html: The Malchut, the Nukva of ZA, takes the lower joint of the Hod of Arich: You already know that the secret of the bottom Hey and the five Gevurot includes all the ZAT, and all the ten Sefirot of Hassadim: for HGT are of the discernment of KHB in Hassadim, and NH are the discernments of ZON of Hassadim — so the Nukva is the discernment of Hod. And this is what he says, that the Nukva of ZA takes the lower joint of the Hod of Arich, since she is exactly the discernment that corresponds to it. And as for why she does not take the whole Hod but only the lower joint alone, this will be explained before us.
